title: Kazushige Matsuda Seminar
excerpt: Kazushige Matsuda Seminar is listed for the 2026 academic year. PEARL students are accepted. Double Degree students are accepted. Language: Japanese only
contentHtml:
This course introduces students to the basic foundation methods in modern macroeconomic analysis and uses them to address long-run macroeconomic issues. The course will start with reviewing macroeconomic models with heterogeneous agents as a toolkit. Next, students will make research proposals and present existing papers their research is built on. Finally, students develop skill to deliver your research effectively.

(Accepting Double Degree)
name: Kazushige Matsuda Seminar
